Who it is for / Shops and retail

Business management software for supermarkets and provision stores in Nigeria.

Relynked runs your supermarket or provision store from one place: your products and prices, how many of each you have in stock, your staff, your money, and every order that comes in on WhatsApp. Remy, the assistant inside Relynked, answers your customers on WhatsApp, tells them what you have and what it costs, and takes their order.

What you get

Everything your supermarket or provision store runs on, in one place.

One account for the whole business, a flat monthly price, and no percentage of your sales.

Products and prices

Put every product on Relynked with its price, in the groups your supermarket or provision store already uses.

Stock

Keep count of how many of each product you have, so you know what is left without walking to the store room.

Orders on WhatsApp

Remy answers customers on WhatsApp, tells them what you have and what it costs, and takes the order.

Your customers

Every customer and what they have ordered, kept in one place.

Staff on the record

Managers and staff log in with their own accounts, so every change has a name on it.

Orders and payments together

Every order and what was paid for it, in one place, without adding up notebooks at the end of the day.

Your products

Set up with the groups you already use.

Relynked starts your products with the groups most supermarkets and provision stores already sort things into, so you add your own products and go.
